product.name: WE-T214 3-in-1 Soil Sensor Transmitter
product.manufacturer: Hainan World Electronic Science And Technology Co., Ltd.
product.description: Industrial soil transmitter for Temperature, Moisture, and EC monitoring with dual 4G and LoRa connectivity, IP67 enclosure, and GNSS positioning.
product.lead: A rugged, field-ready transmitter for precision agriculture. Simultaneously monitors soil temperature, volumetric moisture content, and electrical conductivity (EC). Supports dual 4G and LoRaWAN connectivity for reliable data backhaul in remote areas.
product.og_description: Integrated soil monitor for Temp, Moisture, and EC with dual 4G/LoRa connectivity.

highlights.title: 3-in-1 Precise Sensing
highlights.text: Monitors Soil Temperature, Volumetric Moisture Content, and Electrical Conductivity (EC) simultaneously with a high-accuracy triple-probe sensor.

highlights.title: Dual 4G & LoRaWAN
highlights.text: Flexible connectivity with 4G LTE (MQTT/HTTP) and LoRaWAN (up to 5km range), ensuring data reporting even in extremely remote locations.

highlights.title: GNSS Positioning
highlights.text: Built-in GPS/GLONASS/BDS support for automated asset tracking and mapping of soil data across large plantations.

highlights.title: Ultra-long Endurance
highlights.text: Powered by a 19,000mAh high-capacity lithium battery or optional 40W solar panel for years of maintenance-free operation.

highlights.title: Rugged & Reliable
highlights.text: IP67-rated host and IP68-rated probe enclosure. Engineered for harsh agricultural environments from -40°C to +85°C.

highlights.title: Real-time LCD Display
highlights.text: On-site data viewing via a high-contrast display. View temperature, humidity, and EC levels directly without a mobile device.

specifications.label: Measured Variables
specifications.value: Soil Temperature, Soil Moisture, Soil Conductivity (EC)

specifications.label: 4G Connectivity
specifications.value: LTE FDD B1/3/5/7/20/28; Supports MQTT, HTTP, and WEST cloud protocols

specifications.label: Power Options
specifications.value: 9-30V DC (Typ 24V), 19,000mAh Internal Li-battery, or 40W Solar Panel

specifications.label: Enclosure Rating
specifications.value: Transmitter Host: IP67; Sensor Probe: IP68

specifications.label: Dimensions
specifications.value: 121 x 78 x 51.4 mm (Main unit excluding antenna and cable)

applications.title: Smart Agriculture
applications.text: Automated soil monitoring for greenhouse farming, orchards, and open fields to optimize irrigation cycles and fertilizer application based on real-time EC and moisture data.

applications.title: Environmental Science
applications.text: Long-term research on soil salinity and moisture dynamics in ecological conservation areas, leveraging LoRaWAN for data transmission across remote terrain.
